title: AOSP client: kith app without Google dependencies
description:
A kith client targeting Android Open Source Project (AOSP) builds — devices without Google Play Services (GrapheneOS, CalyxOS, LineageOS, F-Droid users).

Scope:
- All functionality of the Android client, but zero dependency on Google Play Services, FCM, or GMS
- Push via persistent EventSource connection or polling (WorkManager with AlarmManager fallback)
- Notifications via standard Android notification APIs (no FCM)
- Tailscale integration via Tailscale's open-source Android app or VPN API
- Distribution: F-Droid compatible build (reproducible, no proprietary SDKs)
- May share ~90% of code with the Android client via a shared Kotlin module; the push transport is the main divergence
- Target: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose; same UI as Android client
